about_the_game:
What's in the demo?
You'll get your hands on the first 24 levels of the game. Here you will learn the basics, but at the same time you will already be put to the test. Are you a master of momentum? Can you keep the ball rolling?

What will the full game offer?
There are 100 levels to complete, not counting the secret levels, but we're not allowed to talk about those.
Special mechanics are introduced in various stages.

How far done is the development?
It's mainly testing and polishing that is left for us. Also we are still working on the sound effects and music, but the demo already gives a good idea of what to expect.

Anything else to know?
Not really, we worked hard on letting the game teach you how to play. So just get in and see if it tickles your brain in the right way.
We hope you'll have fun! Oh and if you do have fun, maybe add Dubio to your wishlist.

Richard and AJ.

short_description: Dubio is a game of tiny puzzle parcours. It offers a challenging mix of puzzle-solving and momentum control. Jump and bounce through 100 levels that test your wits and sense of timing. Or are there more?
